events.text: Li was born in Nanjing, Qing China.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Li was born in Nanjing , Qing China , on January 28 , 1910

events.text: Li died at National Taiwan University Hospital in Taipei, Taiwan.
events.subject: self
events.quote: died at National Taiwan University Hospital in Taipei , Taiwan on May 31 , 2001

events.text: He graduated from National Central University (Nanjing University).
events.subject: self
events.quote: He graduated from National Central University ( Nanjing University ) in 1930

events.text: He studied physics at Cambridge University.
events.subject: self
events.quote: studied physics at Cambridge University in 1934

events.text: He fled from the Chinese Communist Party to Taiwan with the Nationalist Party.
events.subject: self
events.quote: fled from the Chinese Communist Party to Taiwan in July 1948

events.text: He became the president of the Taiwan Machinery Corporation.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He became the president of the Taiwan Machinery Corporation in 1951

events.text: He was appointed as a member of the Industrial Development Commission.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was appointed as a member of the Industrial Development Commission responsible for the planning and economic development of Taiwan in 1953

events.text: He became the head of the Industrial Development and Investment Center.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1959 he became the head of the Industrial Development and Investment Center

events.text: His term as economic minister ended.
events.subject: self

events.text: His term as finance minister ended.
events.subject: self

events.text: He was appointed Minister without portfolio.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After 1976 he was appointed Minister without portfolio

events.text: He received the Ramon Magsaysay Award for government service.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1968 , he received the Ramon Magsaysay Award for government service
